grille.name: Turning grille
grille.desc: A letter grid and a brass grille you turn by the code

field.phraseHint: What the players will read. Spaces and punctuation are dropped.
field.head: Text on top
field.footHint: E.g. An empty cup holds everything. — L.
field.rowsTip: Side of the square in cells. Empty: the smallest square that fits the phrase; a long one is read in several passes.

problem.empty: Type a phrase to build the letter.
problem.tooLong: Doesn't fit: {letters}, but a {size} square holds at most {max}. Clear “Size” to fit it automatically ({need}×{need}).
problem.tooLongMax: Too long: {letters}, but a letter holds at most {max}. Shorten the phrase.
problem.unsolved: Couldn't build a grille. Press “Shuffle” or change the size.

grille.loop: The code loops: after row {last} comes “{first}” again, without resetting the grille. {passes} in total.

preview.all: Phrase letters are highlighted; each row's code step is on the right
preview.allPasses: Phrase letters are highlighted, colour shows the pass ({passes}); each row's code step is on the right
preview.stepPass: Pass {pass}, step {i} of {n}: row {row}, {turn}, {top} on top

view.plateAria: Grille. Click to turn clockwise, right-click to turn counter-clockwise, arrows to slide, Enter to put back.
view.hintFull: Click the grille to turn it clockwise, right-click to turn it back. Drag to slide it. Q and E turn it from the keyboard.
view.hintPlate: You only have the grille. Click to turn it clockwise, right-click to turn it back.
